name: risk-desk
description: Portfolio risk an agent can drive, from supplied data only: historical and model VaR and Expected Shortfall with backtests, signed linear exposure, Greeks and full revaluation of European options, VaR and ES attribution, limits and pre-trade what-if, liquidity-adjusted VaR, explicit, historical and reverse stress scenarios that carry no probability, SA-CCR and exposure profiles, portfolio credit VaR, FRTB capital pieces, and XVA through a local Open Source Risk Engine project. Research software, not investment advice.

interface.longDescription: Calculate risk from explicit local inputs with skfolio, SciPy, the Option Desk engine and ORE. Preserve loss signs, currencies, horizons, model assumptions and upstream credit.
defaultPrompt: Calculate historical VaR and Expected Shortfall.
Run my local ORE exposure and XVA project.
